rail.$description: The rail: ink in both modes

strong.$description: Rand stark: secondary borders. warm.600 fails 3:1 on band, card and raised.

rail.$description: Text and lines on surface.rail. The same in both modes: the rail stays ink.

off.$description: hollow circle. A shape colour only; label text uses ink.muted.

skeleton.$description: Loading placeholders. A pulse runs from base to highlight; reduced motion keeps base.

scrollbar.$description: Native scrollbars and the ScrollArea bar (design#163). The thumb follows the theme's lines, so a theme that recolours line.strong recolours its bars.

thumb.$description: The resting thumb; 3:1 on every surface

thumb-hover.$description: The thumb under the pointer or while dragged

track.$description: Clear, so the bar sits on its container's own surface

terminal.$description: The 16 ANSI colours of a terminal drawn on surface.page or surface.card. Every one is text-contrast (4.5:1) on both. Lime is green, as elsewhere; magenta and cyan are muted so lime stays the only accent.

black.$description: The lowest grey that stays 4.5:1 on surface.card

chart.$description: Chart series colours in order (design#179): lime, then the muted sky, amber, plum, teal and coral. The terminal hues, read from the palette so a pack that aliases terminal colours to status (kommandant) keeps series apart from tones. Each is 3:1 on surface.page, surface.card and surface.raised. A series that means a state takes status.* instead.

brand.$description: The mark and wordmark. The same in both modes: a logo does not follow the theme.

lime-deep.$description: The mark on light surfaces where lime would fall below 3:1

ink.$description: Flat ink mark; the app icon ground

panel.$description: The ground of the shell's main panel (design#152): a card by default; a pack whose pages lay their own cards on a page ground points it at surface.page.

nav.$description: The shell's active nav cells (design#152). The defaults alias the core; a pack points them at its own pair, e.g. a solid action.primary cell.

active.$description: Fill of the active rail row

active-ink.$description: Text of the active rail row

active-icon.$description: Icon of the active rail row

active-meta.$description: Trailing meta (a count, a Kbd) of the active rail row

tab.$description: Fill of the active phone tab

tab-ink.$description: Text of the active phone tab
